disclaimer: Low, Moderate, and High are model-derived decision-support strata based on development operating references. They are not diagnostic categories or clinically validated risk thresholds.
recommendation_disclaimer: Guideline-informed educational prompts require clinician interpretation; they do not diagnose disease, replace a treatment plan, or prescribe medication. Stratum-specific follow-up priority is a project workflow, not an ADA-endorsed probability cutoff.
target: Physician-diagnosed diabetes status (DIQ010), not prospective incident diabetes
feature_rule_policy: Use observed original inputs only, never imputed values or SHAP signs. Adult measurement conventions apply only when observed age is at least 20. No race-specific actions.

ADA2026_2.label: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026, section 2: Diagnosis and Classification
ADA2026_2.scope: Clinician-directed screening and laboratory/clinical diagnosis; model output is insufficient

ADA2026_3.label: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026, section 3: Prevention or Delay
ADA2026_3.scope: General individualized prevention support; do not infer prediabetes from a model stratum

ADA2026_5.label: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026, section 5: Positive Health Behaviors
ADA2026_5.scope: Individualized nutrition, activity and tobacco-cessation support; no pharmacologic recommendations encoded

NIDDK_BODY.label: NIH/NIDDK: Health Tips for Adults
NIDDK_BODY.scope: Conventional BMI >=25 and waist >40 inches in men or >35 inches in women; review prompts only, not diagnoses

AHA2025_BP.label: 2025 AHA/ACC multisociety blood-pressure guideline
AHA2025_BP.scope: BP review at systolic >=120 or diastolic >=80 mmHg; no diagnosis or treatment decision from a single input

NIH_LIPIDS.label: NIH/MedlinePlus: Cholesterol Levels—What You Need to Know
NIH_LIPIDS.scope: Adult total cholesterol >=200 mg/dL or HDL <40 men / <50 women prompts contextual lipid review

PROJECT_WORKFLOW.label: Project-defined model-derived CDSS workflow v1
PROJECT_WORKFLOW.scope: Risk labels, relative follow-up emphasis, missingness and scope cautions are implementation policy, not validated clinical triage

rules.text: Continue routine preventive care. Discuss diabetes screening according to your age, history, previous results and clinician advice; a LOW model-derived result does not rule out diabetes.
rules.rationale: Avoid false reassurance or suppression of clinically indicated screening

rules.text: Discuss this model result with a qualified health professional. Review whether diabetes screening or laboratory assessment is appropriate given symptoms, age, family history and previous results.
rules.rationale: Clinical context determines whether and how to test

rules.text: Arrange timely clinical review and discuss appropriate diagnostic laboratory testing. This model cannot establish diabetes. Symptoms, abnormal tests or important comorbidities may warrant clinician-directed referral; the clinician determines timing.
rules.rationale: Prioritize review without assigning a diagnosis or arbitrary deadline

rules.text: Seek clinical assessment if symptoms such as increased thirst, frequent urination or unexplained weight loss develop, or if other health concerns arise, regardless of the model result.
rules.rationale: Symptoms and concerns override reassurance from a classification score

rules.text: Review weight, blood pressure and metabolic health during usual preventive visits; follow the monitoring schedule agreed with your clinician.
Review weight/BMI, waist measurements, blood pressure, lipids and other relevant history with your clinician. Reassessment should follow the clinician's advice.

Review previous glucose or HbA1c testing with your clinician, along with blood pressure, weight, waist and lipids. Glucose and HbA1c are not inputs to this model; monitoring depends on clinical assessment.
rules.rationale: Do not substitute nonglycemic model features for diagnostic assessment

rules.text: Maintain or build regular physical activity suited to your abilities, preferences and medical circumstances; discuss suitable activity with your health professional when needed.
rules.rationale: General individualized activity support, without inferring activity level from the model

rules.text: Choose a balanced, nutrient-dense eating pattern that fits your preferences, resources and health needs. A qualified nutrition professional can help individualize it.
rules.rationale: General nutrition support without a prescribed diet or inferred dietary deficit

rules.text: Avoid tobacco and vaping, and maintain abstinence if you do not currently use them.
rules.rationale: General prevention advice; this does not assert current smoking

rules.trigger_description: Observed adult age >=20 and observed BMI >=25 kg/m²
rules.text: The entered BMI meets a conventional adult weight-review threshold. Consider discussing individualized weight-management support; BMI alone does not establish a disease or the right plan for you.
rules.rationale: Observed BMI supports a contextual weight discussion, not a treatment assignment

rules.text: You reported current smoking. Consider evidence-based smoking-cessation counseling or support through a qualified health professional. This prototype does not select medicines.
rules.rationale: Cessation support follows the reported smoking status, not its SHAP contribution

rules.trigger_description: Observed adult age >=20 and systolic >=120 OR diastolic >=80 mmHg
rules.text: An entered blood-pressure measurement may warrant review. Confirm measurement technique and discuss repeat assessment with a healthcare professional; these inputs do not diagnose hypertension.
rules.rationale: Use conventional elevated-BP review conventions without labeling a disease

rules.trigger_description: Observed adult age >=20; waist >101.6 cm for sex=1 or >88.9 cm for sex=2
rules.text: The entered waist measurement exceeds a conventional adult review threshold. Consider discussing central adiposity in your individual clinical context; these thresholds do not apply equally to every person or population.
rules.rationale: NIDDK >40/>35 inch conventions converted exactly using 2.54 cm/inch; no race-specific treatment

rules.trigger_description: Observed adult age >=20; total cholesterol >=200 mg/dL OR HDL <40 for sex=1 / <50 for sex=2
rules.text: An entered lipid measurement may warrant review of the full lipid profile with a clinician. These values alone do not diagnose a lipid disorder or establish a need for treatment.
rules.rationale: Conventional adult reference values prompt a contextual review only

rules.trigger_description: At least one original Core-10 input is missing
rules.text: Some measurements were unavailable and the frozen pipeline imputed them. Confirm the missing information before relying on the result; feature-specific prompts are not triggered by imputed measurements.
rules.rationale: Missingness may reduce robustness and is not an observed abnormality

rules.trigger_description: Observed age is missing or below the development-cohort age of 20
rules.text: The model was developed in adults aged 20 and older. Age is unavailable or outside that scope here; do not rely on the stratum for clinical decisions. Adult measurement rules have not been applied.
rules.rationale: Expose intended-population uncertainty without changing the frozen prediction
